test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_window_hash (k100 UInt64, k10000 UInt64, k1000000 UInt64, k10000000 UInt64, s String, s_unique String, v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_window_hash SELECT number % 100, intHash64(number) % 10000, intHash64(number + 1) % 1000000, intHash64(number + 2) % 10000000, toString(intHash64(number) % 10000), toString(number), number FROM numbers_mt(30000000)
